title: The completion of a Noetherian ring is Noetherian
statement: Let $A$ be a Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $I\subseteq A$ an ideal and $A^\wedge$ the $I$-adic completion of $A$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. Then $A^\wedge$ is a Noetherian ring.

source.place: Lemma Tag 0316 (lemma-completion-Noetherian-Noetherian, line 23065), proof: choosing generators f_1,...,f_n of I, R[[x_1,...,x_n]] -> R^, x_i -> f_i, is surjective and R[[x_1,...,x_n]] is Noetherian; cited in pione.tex, proof of Lemma 0GS2, line 1817

proof.text: Since $A$ is Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], the ideal $I$ is finitely generated: choose $f_1,\ldots,f_n\in A$ ($n\geq0$) with $I=(f_1,\ldots,f_n)$.

source.place: Lemma Tag 0316 (lemma-completion-Noetherian-Noetherian, line 23065), second proof ('It can also be seen directly as follows', lines 23075-23087)

proof.text: By [lem-weil-pbc-power-series-onto-completion] applied to $A$ and $f_1,\ldots,f_n$, there is a surjective ring homomorphism $\Phi:A[[x_1,\ldots,x_n]]\to A^\wedge$ [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series] with $x_i\mapsto f_i$.

source.place: Lemma Tag 0316 (lemma-completion-Noetherian-Noetherian, line 23065), second proof ('It can also be seen directly as follows', lines 23075-23087)

proof.text: Since $A$ is Noetherian, $A[[x_1,\ldots,x_n]]$ is Noetherian [lem-weil-pbc-power-series-noetherian] (Stacks Lemma 0306).

source.place: Lemma Tag 0316, proof, line 23085-23086 citing Lemma 0306 (lemma-Noetherian-power-series, line 6028)

proof.text: $A^\wedge$ receives the surjective ring homomorphism $\Phi$ (step 2) from the Noetherian ring $A[[x_1,\ldots,x_n]]$ (step 3), hence is Noetherian [lem-weil-pbc-surjective-image-noetherian].
